Our research connects undergraduate learning with questions about the biology and applications of *Delftia acidovorans*.

## Projects

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.feature-card}
### Hands-on Microbiology

Students in MB 360 and LSC 170 investigate *Delftia* through laboratory work, spot-plate assays, and analysis of scientific publications.

[Explore student projects](news.qmd)
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Genomics and Bioinformatics

Explore *Delftia* sequences using BLAST and comparative genomics to investigate the organism's biology and environmental capabilities.

[Browse the genomes dashboard](dashboard.qmd#latest-genomes)
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Gold Recovery and E-Waste

Literature-based projects examine *Delftia*'s gold-biomineralizing abilities and their potential relevance to sustainable biotechnology.

[Browse publications](references.qmd)
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Citizen Science and Communication

Community annotation and WikiEDU projects help make research about *Delftia*, including its environmental roles and occurrence in clinical reports, more accessible.

[See community and student contributions](news.qmd)
:::
:::

## Explore and Participate

Follow the [latest publications](dashboard.qmd#latest-publications), meet our [people](people.qmd), or [get involved](about.qmd#get-involved).
